t: The Perfect Kitchen by Barbara Sallick | Goodreads
s: It would have been more credible as a book if it actually made any suggestions as to how to realistically make a beautiful kitchen happen. The main substance comes in the form of several "experts" (food writers, chefs, and cookbook authors, for example) who actually offer helpful advice. If you just want to look at a lot of pretty pictures in an expensive book, this is for you. If, however, you are wanting something more practical, I'm afraid you will have to keep looking. ...
